content: कड् I. €1 <ab>U.</ab> (कडति-ते, कडित) .²1 To be proud. .²2 To unhusk; <ab>cf.</ab> कण्ड्. .²3 To be disturbed or confused. --II. €6 <ab>P.</ab> To eat, consume. --III. €10 <ab>U.</ab> .²1 To protect. .²2 To remove the chaff or husk of grain. .²3 To break off a part, separate or detach, tear.
